## What's new
- **Process Manager.** A new blue button in Remote Tools (where Computer Management was) opens a list of the processes running on the remote PC: name, PID, user, memory and description. Type in the filter box to find a process, and click a column header to sort (click again to reverse).
- **Show Microsoft services** checkbox, off by default. When off, Windows and Microsoft background processes are hidden (Microsoft programs in the Windows folder or running as SYSTEM / LOCAL SERVICE / NETWORK SERVICE). Microsoft apps the user runs, such as Outlook, Teams and Edge, and `explorer.exe` always stay in the list.
- **End Task** ends the selected process after a confirmation (the Delete key does the same). F5 or **Refresh** reloads the list.
- **Computer Management** moved to the end of the Remote Tools buttons.

## Upgrading from v5.3.0
- Extract the new zip over the old folder, or into a new one.
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.4.0-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.
